SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D

September 29, 1936. Morning Translation.

According to another report, Japanese marines,
on bicycles, appeared in the vicinity of Hankow and Szechuen
Roads at 9 a.m. September 28. They acted as if they were
inspecting the place.
Some residents living on Sz Ching Road, near
North Szechuen Road, began to remove their homes on September
28, but were stopped by the Chinese Police.

Mapping of Districts: Transportation of Firearms.

A reporter of the Ta Kung News Agency made
an inspection of Chapel this morning. Some ten Japanese
marines were posted in the vicinity of the Ningpo Guild on
Paoshan Road. When the reporter went up to Ouyang Road
and Hsieng Tek Road behind Scott Road, he saw more than ten
Japanese marines arrive there by motor car, Settlement
licence No.5518, and a motor cycle No.19. They were mapping
the area, and two of them climbed up Electric Pole No.5 to
make a secret mark. The work was directed by two officers
and lasted more than half an hour.
At 8.30 a.m. to-day, two truck-loads of fire-
arms and ammunition were transported to the Japanese Marines
Headquarters from Yangtsepoo; subsequently, the two trucks
were driven to Haining Road. The Japanese marines stationed
at the Yung Feng House on North Szechuen Road and at various
intersections along this road have not been withdrawn.

Watch Tower Erected in Japanese Brewery.

A reporter of the Hwa Tung News Agency noticed
two Japanese transportation trucks numbered 26 and 10 removing
desks etc. from the Kiangwan Road Barracks to Yung Feng House,
the fourth floor of which seemed have been fitted out as an
office for military officers. A row of tanks was parked
in front of the House. Some 30 marines were seen practicing
attacks in a compound off Kung Yieh Road (公業路), from
where an ash road had been constructed to the Japanese
Brewery. Houses have also been built near the Brewery and
a watch tower erected.
The situation in Hongkew is now quiet, and
the Japanese schools have already reopened. According to the
Japanese Consulate, no fresh instructions have been received
from Tokyo or from the Japanese Ambassador from Nanking
during the past twenty-four hours. The situation though
quiet is still serious.

An Inspection at the Scene of the Murder

The scene of the murder of the Japanese
marine at the corner of Haining Road and Woosung Road was
inspected by armed Japanese marines at 10 a.m. to-day who
arrived there in six trucks. One armoured car was parked
in front of the Yung Feng House on North Szechuen Road.
The land of a Japanese Brewery in Chapel is owned by
Japanese.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记处。
编号 D

1936年9月29日。晨间译件。

据另一则报道，9月28日上午9时，骑自行车的日本海军陆战队士兵出现在汉口路与四川路附近。他们的举动仿佛在视察该地。
9月28日，一些住在北四川路附近泗泾路（音译）的居民开始搬家，但被中国警察制止。

区域测绘：枪支运输。

大公通讯社记者今晨对闸北进行了视察。约十名日本海军陆战队士兵部署在宝山路宁波会馆附近。当记者走到斯科特路（音译）后面的欧阳路和亨德路（音译）时，看到十多名日本海军陆战队士兵乘坐一辆汽车（租界牌照号5518）和一辆摩托车（编号19）到达那里。他们正在测绘该区域，其中两人爬上5号电线杆做秘密标记。这项工作由两名军官指挥，持续了半个多小时。
今天上午8时30分，两卡车的枪支弹药从杨树浦运往日本海军陆战队总部；随后，这两辆卡车开往海宁路。驻扎在北四川路永丰大楼及该路各个路口的日本海军陆战队士兵并未撤回。

日本啤酒厂内建起瞭望塔。

华通通讯社记者注意到，两辆编号为26和10的日本运输卡车正将桌椅等物品从江湾路兵营运往永丰大楼，该楼四楼似乎已布置为军官办公室。大楼前停放着一排坦克。约30名陆战队士兵在公业路旁的一处院落里练习进攻，从那里修筑了一条灰渣路通往日本啤酒厂。啤酒厂附近也建造了房屋，并竖起了一座瞭望塔。
目前虹口局势平静，日本学校已经复课。据日本领事馆称，在过去二十四小时内，未收到来自东京或南京日本大使的新指令。局势虽然平静，但仍很严峻。

凶案现场视察

今天上午10时，武装日本海军陆战队士兵乘坐六辆卡车抵达海宁路与吴淞路转角处的日本海军陆战队士兵被杀现场进行视察。一辆装甲车停在北四川路永丰大楼前。
闸北一家日本啤酒厂的土地归日本人所有。

D.7538
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 7538
Date 29 / 9 / 36

September 29, 1936. Afternoon Translation.
Shanghai Evening News dated September 28:-

THE MURDER OF A JAPANESE MARINE

After the murder of a Japanese marine
on Haining Road on September 23, the Chinese authorities
have adopted stricter precautionary measures for the
protection of foreign residents within and without their
jurisdiction. Apart from detailing additional police
to patrol Chapei, parties of Peace Preservation Corps
and Police have been posted for patrol duty every night
until morning in Nantao and in the western district of
Shanghai.

Spies of a certain nation, clad in
Chinese clothing, have been moving about extensively
along a section of the Nanking-Shanghai Railway.

D.7538
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别巡捕房登记处。
编号 D 7538
日期 36年9月29日

1936年9月29日。下午译件。
9月28日《上海晚新闻》报道：

一名日本海军陆战队员被杀案

9月23日一名日本海军陆战队员在海宁路被杀后，中国当局已采取更严格的预防措施，以保护其管辖范围内外的外籍居民。除增派警察在闸北巡逻外，保安队与警察组成的分队每晚至次日清晨在南市及上海西区执行巡逻任务。

某国身着华服的间谍正在京沪铁路沿线一带频繁活动。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 7538
Date 30 / 9 - 36
September 30, 1936. Morning Translation.

Lih Pao (立報) publishes the following letter written by
one Tih Niau (鐵鳥) :

Two Doubtful Points

With the people still excited over the
"unfortunate incidents" which have taken place so closely
one after another, the fatal shooting (?) of a Japanese
marine named Taminoto on Haining Road on the evening of
September 23 has naturally aggravated the already
serious situation. Immediately after the shooting,
the Japanese Naval Landing Party detailed marines to adopt
precautionary measures even within Chinese controlled
territory where they searched pedestrians.
With a view to obtaining a clear understanding
of the incident, I have studied the local Chinese and
foreign newspapers during the past few days.
I entertain some doubt about this incident on
Haining Road; maybe it is due to my mentality. However,
the result of my research and analysis of this incident
strengthens my doubt and I mention hereunder the following
two points of a more conspicuous character in the hope
of attracting the attention of the public:-
(1) Why were there no bloodstains on the ground?
(2) Why was not the corpse shown to the Police for
examination so as to confirm the affair?
There is necessity to study these points
carefully. The other day the papers reported that the
S.M.C., in view of the gravity of the case, had formed a
"Special Search Committee." As a citizen of the Republic
of China, I offer these two points to the public and the
responsible authorities in the hope that they will conduct
a careful investigation so that the case may be solved
as quickly as possible.

Lih Pao publishes the following comment on the letter :-

To-day Tih Niau writes submitting two doubtful
points about the fatal shooting of a marine of a certain
country. It is my belief that such doubts are being
entertained not only by Tih Niau alone but by many other
Chinese and even foreigners. Recently I met two foreign
friends who expressed similar views.
On the surface, a subject of a certain nation
has unfortunately been shot dead. Yet, there is a section
of the public who suspect that there has been no such
killing. I think there is cause for such suspicion.
This certain nation has always practised
deception, therefore her reputation among the world Powers
is not very good. Naturally, people are beginning to
suspect her. She is too despotic. In the case of the
fatal shooting of one of her marines in the International
Settlement, she should have handled the affair in
conjunction with the authorities of the International
Settlement. At present, whenever anything occurs, she
immediately takes the matter into her own hands. How
can she prevent people from suspecting her of ulterior
motives?

编号 D 7538
日期 36年9月30日
1936年9月30日。上午译件。

《立报》刊登一封署名为“铁鸟”的来信：

两点疑窦

民众因接连发生的“不幸事件”而情绪激动之际，9月23日晚一名名叫田Minoto（音译）的日本海军陆战队员在海宁路遭枪击致死（？），自然使原本严峻的局势更加恶化。枪击发生后，日本海军陆战队随即派遣陆战队员进入中国管辖区域采取预防措施，甚至搜查行人。
为了弄清此事真相，笔者近日研读了本地中外报刊。
笔者对海宁路一案存有疑虑；或许这是出于笔者的心理作用。然而，经研究分析此案后，笔者的疑虑反而加深，现列举其中两个较为显著的问题，以期引起公众注意：
(1) 为何地面上没有血迹？
(2) 为何未将尸体交予警方检验以证实此事？
有必要仔细研究这些问题。日前报纸报道，工部局鉴于案情严重，已成立“特别搜查委员会”。作为中华民国公民，笔者向公众及有关当局提出这两点疑问，希望能进行周密调查，以便尽快破案。

《立报》对该信发表如下评论：

今日“铁鸟”撰文，就某国一名海军陆战队员被枪杀一事提出两点疑窦。笔者认为，持有此类疑虑的不仅只有“铁鸟”一人，许多中国人甚至外国人也抱有同感。近日笔者遇见两位外国朋友，他们也表达了类似观点。
表面上看，某国臣民不幸被枪杀。然而，部分公众怀疑并未发生此类杀人事件。笔者认为这种怀疑是有原因的。
该国一贯施行欺骗手段，因此其在世界列强中的声誉不佳。人们自然开始对其产生怀疑。该国过于专横。在其一名海军陆战队员于公共租界被枪杀的案件中，本应会同公共租界当局处理此事。然而目前，每当发生任何事件，该国便立即擅自处理。这怎能不让人怀疑其别有用心？

S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D
Date ...... / ...... / ......
September 30, 1936. Morning Translation.

Supposing that in a place in Japan a foreign resident is killed and his fellow countrymen living at that place immediately remove the body to a hospital of their own in Japan, refuse to permit an examination of the body by the Japanese and cremate the body, while alleging that the deceased had been killed by Japanese. Will not the Japanese entertain some doubt about this allegation?
I am of the opinion that the authorities of this certain nation in Shanghai or in their own land should reflect over Tih Niau's letter. They should carefully consider the causes that have given rise to the suspicion held by the public and reflect whether or not at some time or other they had been guilty of deception and had resorted to arbitrary measures.
It is not nice for a country to be mistrusted by others. It is up to that country to remove the cause of suspicion.

Tung Nan Wan Pao (東南晚報) of September 29 :-

A False Alarm.

At 8 a.m. September 29, the Wayside Police Station received a telephone message reporting that a certain person had pointed a pistol at a person of a certain nation on Yochow Road.
The Police Station immediately detailed a party of Chinese and foreign detectives to make an investigation. They learnt that the telephone message was sent from a steel wire factory, a Japanese establishment, 33 Yochow Road, because at 8 a.m. on that day a Japanese employee of the factory in an upper room noticed a man standing on Yochow Road with his right hand within his clothing and that some kind of article was projecting from his chest, the man's attitude very much resembling that of a person holding a pistol ready to shoot. Greatly alarmed, the Japanese employee reported the matter to the Police. No one was arrested.

Sin Wan Pao (Nanchang telegram) :-

Chiang Kai Shek Orders Precautions Against Reactionaries.

Yesterday General Chiang Kai Shek, Chairman of the Military Affairs Commission, issued the following telegram addressed to the various provincial and city governments :-
"Orders for the protection of foreign residents and the maintenance of peace and order have been repeatedly issued by the National Government. Undesirables are attempting to obstruct the unification of the country, but the unification has now been achieved. According to secret information to hand, unlawful elements have secretly proceeded to the various provinces and cities with the object of creating disturbances. Slackness in precautionary measures is liable to give rise to untoward accidents, thereby affecting the general situation. It is hereby ordered that strict measures are to be adopted by the military and the Police. The people are advised to observe peace and order."

1936年9月30日。上午译件。

假设在日本某地，一名外籍居民被杀，其居住在该地的同胞立即将尸体移至他们在日本的自家医院，拒绝允许日本人验尸，并将尸体火化，同时声称死者是被日本人杀害的。难道日本人不会对这一说法产生疑虑吗？
笔者认为，该国在上海或其本国的当局应当反思“铁鸟”的来信。他们应仔细考虑引起公众怀疑的原因，并反省自己是否曾在某些时候进行过欺骗并采取了武断措施。
一个国家被他人不信任并非好事。消除怀疑根源的责任在于该国自身。

9月29日《东南晚报》报道：

虚惊一场。

9月29日上午8时，路边警察局接到电话报告，称有人在耀州路用枪指着某国人。
警察局立即派遣中西探员组成的小组进行调查。获悉该电话来自耀州路33号的一家日资钢丝厂，因为当天上午8时，该厂一名日本雇员在楼上房间注意到一名男子站在耀州路上，右手插在衣服里，胸部突出某种物品，该男子的姿态极像手持手枪准备射击的人。这名日本雇员大为惊恐，遂向警方报告。无人被捕。

《新晚报》（南昌电报）：

蒋介石下令防范反动分子。

昨日，军事委员会委员长蒋介石将军向各省市省政府发出如下电报：
“国民政府已多次发布保护外籍居民及维持治安的命令。不良分子企图阻碍国家统一，但统一现已实现。据手头秘密情报显示，不法分子已秘密前往各省市，意图制造骚乱。防范措施松懈容易引发意外事故，从而影响大局。兹命令军警采取严厉措施。劝告民众遵守治安秩序。”

September 29, 1936.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 7538.
29. 9. 36
Afternoon Translation

Lih Pao publishes the following comment :-

There Is A Limit To Patience

There is a limit to patience. The marine
of a certain nation was murdered in the International
Settlement, but why were marines of that nation detailed
to Chinese controlled territory to search pedestrians?
Recently a Japanese thief visited the American Embassy
at Tokyo and stabbed the Acting American Ambassador.
By the same process of reasoning, America would have been
entitled to post soldiers for duty in Tokyo and to search
Japanese residents. But the American Government did not
resort to such action. Then why should China be made to
suffer in this manner?
The protest of the Shanghai City Government
is right and proper because marines of this certain nation
are still stationed at Pah Sz Jao and vicinity. We should
not make concessions regarding this matter for, if we do, the
marines will go a step further.
We are not hostile towards the people of this
nation; we are in sympathy with them when one of them is
killed. Yet they have assumed an attitude of hostility
and searched us; naturally, we cannot tolerate this. We
hate those who favour invasion because the aim of the
invaders is to seize China. There is a limit to our
patience; we shall never yield to unreasonable action.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :-

CHINESE DETECTIVE CHARGED WITH TORTURE

Wang Chung Fah (王中業), a Chinese detective
of the French Police, and Chuin Hung Fah (崔鴻發) of
No. 49 Ting Ziang Li (長祥里) off Rue Oriou, French
Concession, are being charged by Yang Ping Lai (楊炳蘭),
the chief tenant of the house mentioned above and Ho Ziang
Foh (胡祥福) at the Shanghai Second Special District
Court with malicious accusation and use of torture to
extract statements, thereby causing them both to sustain
serious injury.
Enquiries made by the French Police show
that Wang Chung Fah, the Chinese detective, had actually
committed these unlawful acts and he was therefore
dismissed from the service. The other day, he was
charged by the French Police before the Court and he was
ordered to be detained.
The case came up for hearing again at the
Court yesterday morning when the accused submitted a
request that he be released on bail because many of the
prisoners in the detention house have threatened to
assault him, but his request was rejected by the Court.
The other accused Chuin Hung Fah was ordered to furnish
$300 cash security. The case was remanded for hearing
on October 2.

《立报》发表如下评论：

忍耐是有限度的

忍耐是有限度的。某国海军陆战队员在公共租界被杀，但为何该国海军陆战队员要进入中国管辖区域搜查行人？
近日，一名日本窃贼潜入东京美国大使馆，刺伤了美国代办大使。依此类推，美国本有权在东京部署士兵并搜查日本居民。但美国政府并未采取此类行动。那么，为何要让中国遭受此种待遇？
上海市政府的抗议是正确且正当的，因为该国海军陆战队员仍驻扎在八字桥及周边地区。我们在此事上不应让步，否则，海军陆战队员将会得寸进尺。
我们对该国人民并无敌意；当其中一人被杀时，我们表示同情。然而他们却采取敌对态度并搜查我们；自然，我们无法容忍这一点。我们憎恨那些支持侵略的人，因为侵略者的目的是夺取中国。我们的忍耐是有限度的；我们绝不会向无理行为屈服。

《新晚报》及其他本地报纸：

华籍侦探被控刑讯逼供

法租界警务处华籍侦探王中业，以及法租界奥里乌路（Rue Oriou）长祥里49号的崔鸿发，被上述房屋的二房东杨炳兰和胡祥福在上海第二特区法院指控犯有恶意诬告及使用酷刑逼供罪，致使二人受重伤。
法租界警务处的调查显示，华籍侦探王中业确实实施了这些非法行为，因此被开除公职。日前，他被法租界警务处在法庭起诉，并被下令拘留。
该案于昨日上午再次开庭审理，被告提出申请要求保释，理由是拘留所内的许多囚犯威胁要殴打他，但法院驳回了其申请。另一名被告崔鸿发被责令缴纳300元现金保释金。案件延期至10月2日审理。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D
September 30, 1936.    Morning Translation... / ... / ...

Lih Pao (立报):

THE HAINING ROAD SHOOTING AFFRAY

The Shanghai First Special District Court has decided to resume on the morning of Saturday, October 3, the hearing of the case against the three suspects named Chang Yung Woo (張榮和), Ma Yung Zai (馬永才) and Ma Yung Nee (馬永年), arrested in connection with the fatal shooting of a Japanese marine named A. Taminato at the corner of Haining and Woosung Roads.
The Shanghai Municipal Police yesterday issued a notice offering a reward of $5,000 for information leading to the arrest of the murderer or murderers of the Japanese marine.

Reconstruction of the Crime

With a view to learning all the facts in the case, the Shanghai Municipal Police at about 8 p.m. yesterday detailed a number of detectives and uniformed policemen to escort the three suspects named Ma Yung Zai, Ma Yung Nee, Chang Yung Woo and his parents, Yue Zang Hai (俞長海), a cooked rice hawker, and his wife Yue Li Sz (俞李氏), in all seven persons, to the scene of the incident on Haining Road for purpose of conducting a reconstruction of the crime. Zang Tai (常泰), the 3-year old son of Yue Zang Hai, the cooked rice hawker, was carried in the arms of his mother Yue Li Sz. The reconstruction was watched by a crowd of more than 1,000 on-lookers, while more than 30 Chinese, foreign and Japanese policemen were present. Strict precautions were adopted by the Police.
At 8 p.m. a fire-cracker to indicate the firing of a shot was let off. Immediately after this, Chang Yung Woo rushed forward from a nearby congee stall at the entrance of an alleyway and was arrested in mid-way by a member of the Japanese Landing Party. Afterwards two other crackers were let off, whereupon Yue Zang Hai indicated the spot where his rice stall was left as well as the direction which his son Zang Tai took when running. The reconstruction of the crime terminated at about 9 p.m.

Study of the Facts at the Time of Shooting

After the reconstruction, the detectives remained at the scene to find out the manner and style of walking of the Japanese marines concerned in the affair, how the pistol was put away by the culprit and other circumstances surrounding the shooting. The investigation terminated at 10 p.m. After this, the four witnesses, namely, the parents of Chang Yung Woo and Yue Zang Hai and his wife, were ordered to return home, while the three suspects Ma Yung Zai, Ma Yung Nee and Chang Yung Woo were taken back in a police van to Hongkew Police Station.
At the time of the reconstruction, Chang Yung Woo was clad in a white cotton coat and a pair of blue trousers, giving the appearance of a country man, while Ma Yung Zai and Ma Yung Nee were dressed in grey cotton long gowns, giving them an appearance of printers. As a matter of fact,

编号 D
1936年9月30日。    上午译件... / ... / ...

《立报》：

海宁路枪击案

上海第一特区法院决定于10月3日（星期六）上午恢复审理涉及海宁路与吴淞路拐角处日本海军陆战队员A. Taminato（音译）被枪杀案的三名嫌疑人张荣和、马永才和马永年的案件。
上海公共租界工部局警务处昨日发布公告，悬赏5,000元，征集能导致逮捕杀害该日本海军陆战队员凶手的情报。

犯罪现场重建

为了查明案件全部事实，上海公共租界工部局警务处于昨晚8时许，派遣多名探员及制服警察押送马永才、马永年、张荣和及其父母、卖熟饭小贩俞长海及其妻俞李氏共七人，前往海宁路案发地点进行犯罪现场重建。卖熟饭小贩俞长海3岁的儿子常泰由其母俞李氏抱在怀中。超过1,000名围观群众观看了重建过程，现场还有30多名中、外及日本警察在场。警方采取了严密的预防措施。
晚上8时，燃放一枚爆竹以示意开枪。随后，张荣和从巷口附近的粥摊冲出，中途被日本陆战队的一名成员逮捕。接着又燃放了两枚爆竹，俞长海指出了他留下饭摊的位置以及其子常泰逃跑的方向。犯罪现场重建于晚上9时许结束。

研究枪击时的事实情况

重建结束后，探员留在现场，以查明涉案日本海军陆战队员的行走方式和步态、罪犯如何收起手枪以及枪击周围的其他情况。调查于晚上10时结束。此后，四名证人，即张荣和的父母以及俞长海夫妇，被令回家，而三名嫌疑人马永才、马永年和张荣和则被警车押回虹口警察局。
在进行现场重建时，张荣和身穿白色棉袄和蓝色裤子，看起来像个乡下人，而马永才和马永年则身穿灰色棉长衫，看起来像印刷工人。事实上，

S. B. REGISTRY.

Morning Translation D
Date / /
September 30, 1936.

the two brothers are workers of the Hung Shing (洪兴)
Printing Company. It is learned that Weung Lai Sung
(汪蘭生), manager of the printing company in question, has
written to the Chinese Ratepayers Association requesting
assistance.

The Lung-an Shell Incident Settled

Li Chi Fah (李智發), proprietor of the Shing Lee
(兴利) Bakery, who was arrested in connection with the
lung-an shell case, was released at 4 a.m. yesterday by the
North Szechuen Road Police Station of the Bureau of Public
Safety. Lih Feng Fah (厲分發), a coolie of the bakery,
who was arrested for throwing the lung-an shell, was regarded
as guilty and has been sentenced to several days' detention.
He is at present being detained at the Bureau of Public
Safety.

Change of Senior Detectives of Hongkew and Dixwell
Road Police Stations Demanded by Japanese

The report to the effect that the Japanese residents
have asked the S.M.C. to replace the senior detectives of
Hongkew and Dixwell Road Police Stations with Japanese
was ascertained to be authentic yesterday. A letter has
been sent to Mr. Fessenden, Secretary-General of the S.M.C.,
by the Japanese Amalgamated Association of Street Unions,
in which they demand an increase in the strength of Japanese
detectives and policemen in the Hongkew District as a
safeguard against a repetition of such unfortunate incidents
as that which occurred on Haining Road.

Sin Wan Pao:

Yesterday the situation along North Szechuen
Road and at the Japanese Rokusan Garden and Pah Sz Jao in
Chapel remained unchanged. The Japanese posts in the
Japanese Brewery behind the Rokusan Garden have not been
withdrawn.
A reporter of the Kuo Min News Agency yesterday
proceeded to the vicinity of Pah Ez Jao in Chapel and Hongkew
District to make an inspection of the district. He
found the situation there more serious than it was before.
Construction of an observation post on the roof of the
Japanese Landing Party Headquarters on North Szechuen Road
was started yesterday. The new post will be 30 feet
higher than the existing watch tower. Japanese marine
sentinels in groups of three's and five's have been posted
at various strategic points in the vicinity of Pah Sz Jao,
West Paoshing Road and at the Japanese January 28 Memorial
Tomb. The construction of an ash road in the vicinity
of Ho Kia Zah, Chapel, was completed yesterday. It is
now being used by military trucks. Sentries in full
military equipment, in groups of four's or five's, have been
posted at the intersections of the various roads on the
extra Settlement roads and North Szechuen Road as well as in
front of the Japanese Landing Party Headquarters, Japanese
primary schools, the office of the Japanese marines at the
Yung Feng Bank and at the end of North Szechuen Road in
Hongkew District. The search of pedestrians has become
stricter.

晨间译件 D

1936年9月30日。

这两兄弟是洪兴印刷公司的工人。据悉，该印刷公司经理汪蘭生（Weung Lai Sung）已致函华人纳税会请求协助。

龙安手榴弹案已结

与龙安手榴弹案有关而被捕的兴利面包店店主李智發（Li Chi Fah），于昨日凌晨4时由公安局北四川路巡捕房释放。因投掷龙安手榴弹而被捕的面包店苦力厲分發（Lih Feng Fah）被认定有罪，并被判处拘留数日。他目前正被拘押在公安局。

日本人要求更换虹口及狄思威路巡捕房的高级侦探

据报，日本侨民已要求工部局将虹口及狄思威路巡捕房的高级侦探更换为日本人，此消息昨经证实属实。日本各马路同业公会已致函工部局总办费信惇（Fessenden）先生，要求在虹口区增加日本侦探和巡捕的人数，以防海宁路此类不幸事件重演。

《新闻报》：

昨日，北四川路沿线以及闸北罗三花园和八字桥附近的局势保持不变。罗三花园后方日本啤酒厂内的日本哨位并未撤除。
国闻通讯社一名记者昨日前往闸北八字桥附近及虹口区视察该地区。他发现那里的局势比以前更为严峻。
位于北四川路日本海军陆战队司令部屋顶上的观察哨建设已于昨日动工。新哨位将比现有的瞭望塔高出30英尺。三五成群的日本海军陆战队哨兵已被部署在八字桥、西宝兴路附近以及“一·二八”纪念墓周边的各个战略要点。闸北何家宅附近的灰渣路已于昨日完工。目前军用卡车正在使用该道路。全副武装的四五名一组的哨兵已被部署在越界筑路与北四川路各路口交汇处，以及日本海军陆战队司令部、日本小学、永丰银行内的日本海军陆战队办公室前和虹口区北四川路尽头。对行人的搜查变得更加严格。

Chinese Bankers' Club, 59 Hongkong Road, During the
proceedings, officers to supervise the drive for new
members were appointed.

Proclamation issued by the Shanghai City Government - posted
in Chapei and Nantao

Copies of a proclamation issued by the Shanghai City
Government urging the Chinese people to maintain friendship
with other nations and not indulge in anti-foreign movements
(full translation appears in I.R. of Sept. 25, 1936) were
posted in Chapei and Nantao on September 26.

Labour

Heng Tai Silk Filature - closed down

The Heng Tai Silk Filature, 358 Koo Ka Wan (□□□),
Chapei, closed down on September 24 owing to dissension
among the shareholders of the concern. A complement of
400 workers and 20 staff employees were affected.

An agreement has been reached between the workers and
the management, whereby the latter will issue retiring
gratuities equivalent to two months' wages to the workers.
The 20 staff employees are, however, demanding retiring
gratuities equivalent to 4 months' wages.

Yee Loong and Ching Yue Silk Filatures - workers form
credit and cooperative society

A new organization entitled "The Shanghai Northern

September 27, 1936. Morning Translation

China Times and other local newspapers :-

THE FATAL SHOOTING OF A JAPANESE MARINE

At 8 a.m. yesterday, Japanese marines stationed at the Japanese Cemetery at Pah Sz Jao (八字桥) began to mobilize and afterwards Japanese marines stationed in the Rokusan Garden were also mobilized. They went to the large compound at the corner of Heng Yih Road (恒業路) and Lun Ton Road (倫敦路). The compound occupies an area of about 60 li and is surrounded by a black fence. Some 200 Japanese marines were congregated there and five military trucks later appeared.

Our reporter yesterday proceeded to the place and found the Japanese marines removing the machine guns. Some marines were cutting the grass and constructing defensive works. Camps were established. Only a few Japanese marines were stationed in the Japanese Cemetery and the Rokusan Garden, while only three to five marines guarded the crossing of the Woosung-Shanghai Railway at Tien Tung An. In the International Settlement, Japanese marines and Chinese Police are being stationed on North Szechuen Road and at intersections between the Settlement and Chinese controlled territory. A Japanese armoured car was parked at the corner of Dixwell and Jukong Roads. The Japanese marines at the Japanese Club on Boone Road have been withdrawn.

At 3 p.m. yesterday, two Japanese marines placed a military telephone on North Szechuen Road near Wang Pang Jao.

At 11.40 a.m. yesterday a bullet from the revolver of a Japanese sentinel hit the signboard of the Kwang Zung Cantonese Restaurant (廣誠粵菜館) at the corner of North Szechuen Road and Jukong Road and dropped near the wall of the Tung Fang Hosiery Factory (東方襪廠). Nobody was injured. A Japanese official said that the shot was discharged through an accident when the sentinel was cleaning his revolver.

The Happyland Dance Hall Incident

Huang Lin Siao (黄凌霄) and Hsu Chao Nin (許兆銀) of the Lo Sun Dance Research Society (樂声跳舞研究會) were arrested on September 24 by the Chinese Police on suspicion of throwing the pear feelings from the Zung Foong (順風) (Happyland) Dance Hall. Having ascertained that the two men had no connection with the affair, the North Station Branch of the Public Safety Bureau released them on September 26.

China Daily Herald (中國導报) (Chinese Section) (formerly The New World) published the following comment on Sept. 26 :-

On the evening of September 23, a shooting affray took place at the corner of Woosung Road and Haining Road, in which a Japanese marine was killed and two others were wounded. The Shanghai Municipal Police and the Public Safety Bureau are co-operating in the search for the assassins.

(印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER (CRIME BRANCH))

1936年9月27日。晨间译件

《时报》及其他本地报纸：

日本海军陆战队员被枪杀案

昨日早上8时，驻扎在八字桥日本公墓的日本海军陆战队员开始动员，随后驻扎在罗三花园的日本海军陆战队员也进行了动员。他们前往恒业路和伦敦路转角处的大院。该大院占地约60亩，四周环绕着黑色围栏。约200名日本海军陆战队员聚集在那里，随后出现了五辆军用卡车。

本报记者昨日前往该地，发现日本海军陆战队员正在拆卸机枪。一些陆战队员正在割草并修筑防御工事。营地已经建立。日本公墓和罗三花园仅驻守少数日本海军陆战队员，而在天通庵吴淞铁路交叉口，仅有三至五名陆战队员守卫。在公共租界内，日本海军陆战队员和中国警察被部署在北四川路以及租界与中国管辖区域的交界处。一辆日本装甲车停在狄思威路和曲阳路转角处。布恩路日本俱乐部的日本海军陆战队员已撤离。

昨日下午3时，两名日本海军陆战队员在北四川路近王邦桥处架设了一部军用电话。

昨日上午11时40分，一名日本哨兵左轮手枪射出的一颗子弹击中了北四川路与曲阳路转角处广诚粤菜馆的招牌，并掉落在东方袜厂的墙边。无人受伤。一名日本官员称，该枪击是哨兵在擦拭左轮手枪时意外走火所致。

百乐门舞厅事件

乐声跳舞研究会的黄凌霄（Huang Lin Siao）和許兆銀（Hsu Chao Nin）因涉嫌从顺风（百乐门）舞厅投掷物品，于9月24日被中国警察逮捕。经查实两人与此事无关后，公安局北站分局于9月26日将他们释放。

《中国导报》（中文版）（前身为《新世界》）于9月26日发表如下评论：

9月23日晚，吴淞路与海宁路转角处发生枪战，一名日本海军陆战队员身亡，另两人受伤。上海公共租界工部局警务处与公安局正合作搜捕凶手。

（印：副总监（刑事科））

September 27, 1936. Morning Translation.

The Japanese authorities say that a political motive lies behind the shooting, but this is without foundation.
Every Chinese who loves his country is aware of the complicated political relations between China and Japan; he also knows full well that acts of terrorism are of no use at all and that the killing of innocent Japanese will only render Sino-Japanese relations more tense. For these reasons we can say that the Haining Road shooting affray has no political motive whatever. All the authorities concerned should remain calm.
The Chinese people and the Chinese Government cannot be held responsible for a crime committed by an individual Chinese in the same manner that the Japanese Government cannot be held accountable for the action of any individual Japanese against a foreigner. By adopting a policy of mutual respect and friendship, all Sino-Japanese complications may be solved.

Great Daily News (大日報) published on September 25 the following article contributed by Yang Kwang (楊光) :-

THE STRIKING OF RICSHA COOLIES WITH BATONS

It seems that the baton in the hands of a policeman has an ever lasting grudge against the flesh of ricsha coolies; in other words, it seems that the baton in the hands of a policeman is used exclusively for the purpose of striking ricsha coolies. There is no necessity for policemen to strike ricsha coolies; it is inhuman. Ricsha coolies are already greatly scared at the approach of x policemen whom they regard as the "petty devils" of "Yen-Loh-Wang" (the King of the Hades).
The removal of a ricsha licence or cushion by a policeman is already a very serious matter to the ricsha coolies, therefore the striking of ricsha coolies by policeman is utterly unnecessary from every point of view.
The authorities at Nanking recently issued an order prohibiting policemen from striking ricsha coolies recklessly. This is a good measure. England, the U.S.A., France and various other nations have boasted that they are civilized nations, therefore, I appeal, on behalf of ricsha coolies in the Foreign Settlements and in Chinese controlled territory of Shanghai, to these authorities to promulgate as soon as possible an order prohibiting policemen from assaulting ricsha coolies.

1936年9月27日。晨间译件。

日本当局称枪击背后有政治动机，但这毫无根据。
每一个爱国的中国人都清楚中日之间复杂的政治关系；他也完全知道恐怖主义行为毫无用处，杀害无辜日本人只会使中日关系更加紧张。基于这些原因，我们可以说海宁路枪击案没有任何政治动机。有关各方应保持冷静。
不能因为个别中国人犯下的罪行而追究中国人民和中国政府的责任，正如不能因为任何个别日本人对付外国人的行为而追究日本政府的责任一样。通过采取相互尊重和友好的政策，所有中日纠纷均可得到解决。

《大日报》于9月25日刊登了杨光撰写的以下文章：

用警棍殴打人力车夫

似乎警察手中的警棍与人力车夫的血肉有着永恒的仇怨；换句话说，似乎警察手中的警棍专门用来殴打人力车夫。警察没有必要殴打人力车夫；这是不人道的。人力车夫已经非常害怕警察的到来，他们视警察为“阎罗王”（地狱之王）的“小鬼”。
警察没收人力车执照或坐垫对人力车夫来说已经是非常严重的事情，因此从各方面来看，警察殴打人力车夫都是完全不必要的。
南京当局最近发布命令，禁止警察随意殴打人力车夫。这是一项良好的措施。英国、美国、法国和其他各国都自诩为文明国家，因此，我代表上海外国租界和中国管辖区域内的人力车夫，呼吁这些当局尽快颁布禁止警察袭击人力车夫的命令。

MAINICHI, NIPPO AND NICHI-NICHI

Tokyo , September 25.
On the morning of September 25,
Mr. Amano, Chairman of the Japanese Residents
Corporation at Shanghai , called on Mr. Kuwajima,
officer in charge of the Asia Bureau of the Foreign
Office, and informed him of the anti-Japanese atmosphere
in Shanghai. He further informed the officer that
the methods of the assassins in the Nakayama murder
in November 1935 and the Kayau murder in July, 1936
were identical and that this indicated that it was an
organized anti-Japanese movement. Mr. Amano stated
that a second outbreak of Sino-Japanese hostilities
would result should the anti-Japanese feeling be
allowed to grow stronger. Japanese residents had
suffered heavy losses through the anti-Japanese
movement and the high tariff and if the present state
of affairs be left unchecked Japanese interests and
rights in China would be entirely lost. For this reason,
he expressed the hope that the Government would present
strong demands to the National Government so as to
cause it to reflect and should the National Government
still fail to show sincerity, he asked that the Japanese
Government protect Japanese interests with a powerful
force.

On the same afternoon Mr.
Amano visited the War, Navy and Finance Ministries
and conferred with the officers on the Customs tariff.

CONFERENCE HELD BY HIGH JAPANESE OFFICIALS
IN SHANGHAI; RESULT WIRED TO TOKYO

At 10.30 a.m. yesterday
Naval Attaché Sato, Military Attaché Kita and high
diplomatic officials in Shanghai held a conference
at the Japanese Embassy.
Naval Attaché Sato and Military
Attaché Kita, who had strongly advised Ambassador
Kawagoe to cease the negotiations with the Chinese
authorities, conveyed to those present the Ambassador's
views. The meeting then discussed the attitude
to be adopted, as the National Government has shown
no sincerity and another incident has taken place in
Shanghai which requires a fundamental resolution.
All the officials present
finally reached a certain decision on the attitude
to be taken. The decision will be wired to the
Navy, the War and the Foreign Ministries.

《每日》、《日报》和《日日》

东京，9月25日。
9月25日上午，上海日本居留民团团长天野先生拜访了外务省亚洲局局长桑岛先生，并向其通报了上海的反日气氛。他还告知该局官员，1935年11月的中山谋杀案和1936年7月的加藤谋杀案中刺客的手法相同，这表明这是一场有组织的反日运动。天野先生表示，如果反日情绪继续增强，将导致中日敌对行动再次爆发。日本侨民因反日运动和高关税遭受了重大损失，如果听任当前事态发展而不加制止，日本在华利益和权利将彻底丧失。为此，他表示希望日本政府向国民政府提出强烈要求，促使其反思；如果国民政府仍不表现出诚意，他请求日本政府以强大武力保护日本利益。

同日下午，天野先生访问了陆军省、海军省和大藏省，并与官员们就关税问题进行了磋商。

驻沪日本高级官员举行会议；结果电告东京

昨日上午10时30分，海军武官佐藤、陆军武官北田以及驻沪高级外交官员在日本大使馆举行了会议。
曾强烈建议川越大使停止与中国当局谈判的海军武官佐藤和陆军武官北田，向与会者传达了大使的观点。会议随后讨论了应采取的态度，因为国民政府未表现出诚意，且上海又发生了一起需要根本解决的事件。
所有与会官员最终就应采取的态度达成了一定决定。该决定将电告海军省、陆军省和外务省。

September 26, 1936.
Morning Translation.

Nippo, Mainichi and Nichi Nichi §

EMERGENCY MEETING OF JAPANESE AMALGAMATED STREET UNIONS

At 4 p.m. September 25 an emergency general
meeting of the Japanese Amalgamated Association of Street
Unions was held at the Japanese Club to discuss the situation.
About 70 persons, including the chairman and other officers
of 40 street unions, were present.
Mr. Kondo, Chairman of the Standing Committee,
who presided, spoke as follows :-
"The lives and property of Japanese residents
are being menaced by acts of anti-Japanese terrorism. The
last emergency meeting of this association was held on
July 14 to discuss the Kayau murder case. The present
meeting has been called in accordance with a resolution
passed at an urgent meeting of the Standing Committee held
on September 24. Arrangements for maintaining communications
and the duties to be performed by each street union should
the situation become worse are to be discussed".
Mr. Hayashi, Honorary Chairman of the association,
said :- "A fixed plan for action in case of emergency
should be drawn up as was done during the Sino-Japanese
hostilities in Shanghai. It is expected that the situation
may become aggravated, as a result of the National Government's
insincerity".
Mr. Kondo then proposed that arrangements for
the maintenance of communications and the duties to be
performed by each street union be quickly drawn up.
The proposal was unanimously passed.
The following sections were then established:-
a section for close touch with every member union; a section
to deal with correspondence; a section to keep records;
a section to deal with general business; a section to
handle relief affairs; a section to deal with provisions;
a section to deal with intelligence reports; a section to
deal with refugees; a section to deal with postal affairs;
a liaison section; an accounts section; a police section.

Nichi Nichi §

CHINESE PLAIN CLOTHES CORPS ACTIVE & CHINESE AND JAPANESE
MERCHANTS THREATENED: ASSASSINATION CORPS SMUGGLED INTO
INTERNATIONAL SETTLEMENT

Last night, a well-dressed Chinese appeared at
a certain Japanese shop in Hongkew and speaking in fluent
Japanese said that he was a military spy of a certain army
and that he carried a pistol. As the proprietor of the
shop was about to telephone to the Police, the man left
the premises.
At 1 a.m. to-day a certain quarter received
information to the effect that over ten members of the
plain clothes corps have secretly entered the Settlement.
For this reason, the members of the Japanese Ex-Service
Men's Association are standing by.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 28 SEP. 1936 CRIME BRANCH）

《日本新闻》、《每日新闻》及《日日新闻》§

日本各街道联合会紧急会议

9月25日下午4时，日本街道联合协会在 Japanese Club（日本俱乐部）召开紧急全体会议，讨论当前局势。出席会议者约70人，包括40个街道联合会的主席及其他职员。
常务委员会主席近藤先生主持会议，并发表如下讲话：
“日本侨民的生命财产正受到反日恐怖主义行为的威胁。本协会上一次紧急会议于7月14日举行，讨论了加藤谋杀案。本次会议是根据9月24日常务委员会紧急会议通过的决议召开的。会议将讨论若局势恶化，各街道联合会应如何保持通讯联络以及各自应履行的职责。”
该协会名誉主席林先生说：“应当像上海中日冲突期间那样，制定一份应对紧急情况的固定行动计划。鉴于国民政府缺乏诚意，预计局势可能会加剧。”
随后，近藤先生提议迅速制定保持通讯联络及各街道联合会应履行职责的安排。
该提议获一致通过。
随后设立以下各组：与各会员联合会保持密切联系的组；处理信件的组；记录组；处理一般事务的组；处理救济事务的组；处理给养的组；处理情报报告的组；处理难民事务的组；处理邮政事务的组；联络组；会计组；警务组。

《日日新闻》§

中国便衣队活动频繁，中日商人受威胁：暗杀队被偷运入国际租界

昨晚，一名衣着考究的中国人出现在虹口的一家日本商店，用流利的日语声称自己是某支军队的军事间谍，并携带手枪。当店主正准备打电话报警时，此人离开了现场。
今日凌晨1时，某区收到情报，称十余名便衣队成员已秘密进入租界。为此，日本退伍军人协会成员正处于待命状态。

（印：副警务总监 1936年9月28日 罪案科）

September 26, 1936. Morning Trans No D
Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers :-
THE FATAL SHOOTING OF A JAPANESE MARINE ON HAINING ROAD.
The situation in Hongkew on September 25
improved slightly. The Japanese marines on guard in Chapei
were gradually withdrawn. The three suspects arrested on
the evening of September 23 were handed over to the Shanghai
Municipal Police by the Japanese Consular Police. The
Chinese Authorities have instructed all the subordinate
organs to render assistance in the search for the assassins.
Yesterday our reporter made a tour of Chapei
and found the situation had improved. There were still
several Japanese marines stationed at the Japanese Cemetery
at Pah Sz Jao (八字桥) and in the Rokusen Garden, Chapei,
but the Japanese sentinels on Recreation Road, Wang Loh Road
and along the western district of the Woosung-Shanghai Rail-
way Line had been completely withdrawn. Japanese marines
patrolled the Extra-Settlement Roads area but did not search
pedestrians. Owing to the large number of Japanese
residents in Woosung Road and Miller Road, special
precautionary measures were adopted in this area.
The three suspects arrested on the night of
September 23 in the vicinity of the place where the murder
took place were arraigned before the First Special District
Court on the morning of September 25. As further
investigations are necessary, the Court adjourned the
hearing until October 3.
How the Three Suspects Were Arrested
Ma Yung Zai (馬永才), age 30, and Ma Yung
Nee (馬永年), age 27, brothers, natives of Kating, residing
at No. 9 Zai Chi Li (瑞吉里), Kashing Road, are in the
employ of the Hung Shing Printing Company (洪興印刷所),
No. 24 Zai Ai Li (瑞愛里), Lane No. 406, Shaihaikwan Road.
Ma Yung Zai is a compositor, while Ma Yung Nee is a printer.
Sometime after 8 p.m. September 23 they were passing the
corner of Haining and Woosung Roads on their way home.
The shooting incident had already taken place. All traffic
in the area was stopped so they decided to go by way of
North Haining Road. They then entered a small alleyway,
at the entrance of which the shooting had occurred.
Japanese marines who were on guard in the alleyway arrested
the two brothers. The policeman on post duty there
reported the matter to Hongkew Police Station and Chinese
and foreign officers were detailed to call at the Japanese
Marine Headquarters and to demand that the two suspects
be handed over to the Police for investigations. The two
brothers were handed over to the Police at 10.30 a.m.
September 24.
Chang Yung Woo (張榮和), age 21, another
suspect, lives at No. 8 Sin Zai Kong Li (新瑞康里), Dixwell
Road. He is a congee hawker. At the time of the shooting,
he was selling his wares at the entrance of Lane 240,
South Haining Road. Chang's two fellow provincials had
their congee stalls at a place about 20 to 30 feet from
spot where the shooting was going on. Fearing that they
might be involved in the incident, Chang left his stall
after the shooting to find out if anything had happened
(印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 28 SEP 1936 CRIME BRANCH)

1936年9月26日。晨间译件 D号
《大公报》及其他本地报纸：
海宁路一名日本海军陆战队员遭枪击身亡。
9月25日，虹口的局势略有改善。驻守闸北的日本海军陆战队员逐渐撤出。9月23日晚被捕的三名嫌疑人已由日本领事馆警察移交给上海公共租界工部局警务处。中国当局已指示所有下属机构协助搜捕凶手。
昨日，本报记者巡视了闸北，发现局势有所好转。八字桥的日本墓地及闸北的六三花园仍有数名日本海军陆战队员驻守，但娱乐路、王洛路及吴淞-上海铁路线西段沿线的日本哨兵已完全撤离。日本海军陆战队员在越界筑路区域巡逻，但未搜查行人。由于吴淞路和米勒路日本居民众多，该地区采取了特别的预防措施。
9月23日晚在案发地点附近被捕的三名嫌疑人，于9月25日上午在第一特区法院出庭受审。因需进一步调查，法院将听证会延期至10月3日。
三名嫌疑人被捕经过
马永才，30岁，马永年，27岁，兄弟二人，嘉定籍，住嘉兴路瑞吉里9号，受雇于沙海观路406弄瑞爱里24号的洪兴印刷所。马永才为排字工，马永年为印刷工。
9月23日晚8时许，二人在回家途中经过海宁路与吴淞路转角处。此时枪击事件已经发生。该区域交通全部中断，因此他们决定改走海宁北路。随后他们进入一条小巷，枪击案正是在巷口发生的。在巷内警戒的日本海军陆战队员逮捕了这两兄弟。在此执勤的巡警向虹口巡捕房报告了此事，中外警官随即被派往日本海军陆战队总部，要求将两名嫌疑人移交警方进行调查。两兄弟于9月24日上午10时30分移交警方。
张荣和，21岁，另一名嫌疑人，住狄思威路新瑞康里8号。他是卖粥的小贩。枪击发生时，他正在海宁南路240弄口售卖货物。张的两名同乡在距离枪击发生地约20至30英尺的地方摆着粥摊。担心受到牵连，枪击发生后张离开摊位去查看他们是否安好
（印：副警务总监 1936年9月28日 罪案科）

to them but found them safe. As Chang was walking near
a sand box at the entrance of an alleyway, several Japanese
marines on patrol duty arrested him because a Mauser pistol
had been found in this box. On the evening of September 24
he was handed over to the Police.
In Court yesterday, all the three suspects
declared that they did not know for what reason they had
been arrested.

Another Suspect Taken Into Custody

At 9.30 p.m. yesterday, while Yui Sz Keng (俞書根),
age 23, native of Taiyang (丹陽), a book-binder, was reading
a notice posted by the Japanese Naval Landing Party near
the Hongkew Theatre (虹口), Haining Road, he was arrested
by Japanese marines and taken to the Japanese Marine
Headquarters for questioning. Later Hongkew Police Station
held the man for investigation.

A few days ago, some person. in the Zung Foong
(順風) (Happyland) Dance Hall, North Szechuen Road, threw
out some pear peelings which dropped beside a Japanese
marine patrol. Upon ascertaining that it was Huang Lin
Siao (黃林霄) and Hsu Chao Nin (許兆仁), two teachers
of the Lo Sun Dance School (樂生跳舞學校), North Szechuen
Road, who had thrown out the pear peelings, the Chinese
Police arrested them at 11 p.m. September 24. The report
that the Chinese Authorities had arrested the assassins
responsible for the Haining Road shooting case is untrue.

Hwa Mei Wan Pao :-

Views of the Settlement Authorities

With reference to the shooting affray in Hongkew,
a reporter of this paper called at the S.M.C. for information
at noon yesterday.
Speaking in a spirited manner, an official of
the S.M.C. declared that the Chinese Government and the
Shanghai City Government had always protected Japanese
residents to the best of their ability.
Continuing, he said:- "In normal times
Japanese marines in white uniforms are to be found wandering
on the streets in groups or in front of cabarets at night.
The sight of these marines in white uniforms is liable to
irritate certain unlawful elements. The present incident
was caused by such elements with the object of aggravating
Sino-Japanese relations. In my opinion, the first step
that should be taken to settle the matter is to bring about
the withdrawal of the marines now posted on the streets.
The official view of the S.M.C. is that the occupation of
the streets by the Japanese on the evening of the incident
was such that it was sufficient to obstruct the search
by the Settlement Police for the assassins. If the Hongkew
area had not been occupied by Japanese troops that night,
the work of the Settlement Police would not have been
handicapped and the assassins might have been arrested
earlier (?)."

结果发现他们安然无恙。当张走到一条小巷入口处的沙箱附近时，几名巡逻的日本海军陆战队员逮捕了他，因为在该沙箱中发现了一支毛瑟手枪。他于9月24日晚被移交警方。
昨日在法庭上，三名嫌疑人均声称不知道为何被捕。

另一名嫌疑人被拘留

昨晚9时30分，俞书根，23岁，丹阳籍，装订工，在海宁路虹口大戏院附近阅读日本海军陆战队张贴的公告时，被日本海军陆战队员逮捕，并带往日本海军陆战队总部讯问。随后由虹口巡捕房扣留该男子以作调查。

数日前，有人在北四川路顺风（Happyland）舞厅向外扔梨皮，落在一名日本海军陆战巡逻队员身旁。经查实扔梨皮者为北四川路乐生跳舞学校的两名教师黄林霄和许兆仁后，中国警察于9月24日晚11时逮捕了他们。有关中国当局已逮捕海宁路枪击案凶手的报道不实。

《华美晚报》：

租界当局的观点

关于虹口枪击事件，本报记者于昨日中午前往工部局采访。
工部局一名官员情绪激动地表示，中国政府及上海市政府一直尽力保护日本侨民。
他接着说：“在平时，身穿白色制服的日本海军陆战队员成群结队在街上闲逛，或夜间出现在歌舞厅前。这些身穿白制服的海军陆战队员的出现容易激怒某些不法分子。此次事件正是由这类分子制造，旨在加剧中日关系紧张。我认为，解决此事的第一步应是促使目前部署在街头的海军陆战队员撤离。工部局的官方观点是，事发当晚日本人对街道的占领程度足以阻碍租界警察对凶手的搜捕。如果那晚虹口地区未被日军占领，租界警察的工作就不会受到阻碍，凶手或许能更早被捕（？）。”

September 26, 1936.    Morning Translation.

Asked by the reporter as to what he thought was
the motive behind the Haining Road murder, the official
replied that responsible officers of the S.M.C. were of
the opinion that it was the work of the anti-Chinese
Government party.
Asked whether, in his opinion, similar incidents
were likely to occur again in Shanghai, the official replied:-
"It is hard to say for the present and until the Japanese
troops are withdrawn to their billets."
According to other information from the S.M.C.,
when the Japanese Consul-General made a protest to the
S.M.C. at 3 p.m. yesterday, Mr. Fessenden, Secretary-General
of the S.M.C., formally requested that the Japanese troops
be withdrawn to their barracks.

China Evening News of September 25 published the following
editorial :-

Present State of Sino-Japanese Relations.

All peace-lovers regret that the progress of
Sino-Japanese rapprochement has met with a further obstruction
through the murder of a Japanese marine in Hongkew. The
case occurred within the International Settlement, but
Japanese marine posts were established in places under the
jurisdiction of the Chinese Authorities. In Hongkew,
Japanese marines took over the police duties as if to say
that they are the only persons who are able to direct
affairs to-day. At Tokyo, a strong policy was decided
upon at the conference held by the Ministers of Navy, Army
and Foreign Affairs, and according to telegraphic reports,
reinforcements may be sent should the situation become
aggravated. On no occasion has tension run so high since
the September 18 Incident as in the present case.
Leaving aside the question of the rights or
wrongs in the case, we should calmly consider what effect
the affair will have upon the peace of Asia, particularly
upon the future relations between China and Japan. It
may be well to ask whether we should allow the affair to
develop into a war or to take definite steps to prevent
this in time. No wise observer would say that a war would
benefit China; on the other side, the Japanese people have
frequently been warned by their loyal compatriots that if
they were to go to war they would only be digging their
own graves.
Chinese and Japanese belong to the same race
and have the same kind of culture; they should really be
good neighbours. Unfortunately, a proud and haughty
attitude of superiority has been created in the minds of
the Japanese people by the actions of the Japanese
militarists who are continually invading Chinese territory
and encroaching upon Chinese sovereign rights. The
Japanese people have been taught to think that China will
always submit. As a result, two peoples which should be
friendly to each other have become enemies. This is a
great misfortune to the peace-loving peoples of the
Orient.

当记者问及他认为海宁路谋杀案背后的动机是什么时，该官员回答说，工部局负责官员认为这是反中国政府党派所为。
当被问及在他看来上海是否可能再次发生类似事件时，该官员回答说：“目前很难说，直到日军撤回营地为止。”
据来自工部局的其他消息，当日本总领事于昨日下午3时向工部局提出抗议时，工部局秘书长费森登先生正式要求日军撤回兵营。

9月25日出版的《中国晚报》刊登了以下社论：

中日关系现状。

所有爱好和平的人士都对中日亲善进程因虹口一名日本海军陆战队员被杀而再遇阻碍感到遗憾。该案发生在国际租界内，但日本海军哨位却设在中国当局管辖的地区。在虹口，日本海军陆战队员接管了警察职责，仿佛只有他们才能主导当今的事务。在东京，海军、陆军和外务大臣举行的会议上决定了强硬政策，据电报报道，若局势恶化，可能会派遣增援部队。自九一八事变以来，紧张局势从未像本案这样高涨。
撇开案件是非曲直不谈，我们应冷静考虑此事将对亚洲和平，特别是中日未来关系产生何种影响。不妨问问，我们是任由事态发展为战争，还是及时采取明确措施加以防止。任何明智的观察者都不会说战争对中国有利；另一方面，日本忠贞同胞也经常警告日本人民，如果发动战争，只会是自掘坟墓。
中日两国同种同文，本应是好邻居。不幸的是，日本军国主义者不断入侵中国领土、侵犯中国主权的行为，在日本人民心中造成了一种傲慢自大的优越感态度。日本人民被灌输认为中国总会屈服的思想。结果，两个本应友好的民族变成了敌人。这对东方爱好和平的人民来说是一大不幸。

September 26, 1936.    Morning Translation. /

Such is the psychology of the two peoples,
but a wise government should never allow it to develop to
such a degree that a war would become inevitable; the people
should be warned of the dangers that would befall them.
During the various stages of development
in Sino-Japanese relations, the Chinese Government has
warned, instructed and led its people to take the safest
course. But what has the Japanese Government done on its
part? It has created a haughty feeling of superiority in
the minds of its people. In the present incident, the
Japanese leaders have exhibited signs of irritation similar
to those manifested by the people. The leaders seem to be
following the people blindly instead of pausing to reflect.
The recent arrival at Nanking of Ambassador
Kawagoe gave rise to hopes for an adjustment of the relations
between China and Japan. We hope the views of the Japanese
leaders towards the important question of readjustment of
Sino-Japanese relations will not be obscured by a few
haphazard incidents. We also hope that they will not
be influenced by the feelings of the people, but will
reflect and give some consideration for the peace of Asia
and for the future relations between the two nations. A
settlement of all Sino-Japanese problems will depend upon
the Japanese Authorities coming to a proper realization of
the situation.

Shun Pao publishes the following editorial :-

Following the incident that took place
in Hongkew on the night of September 23 in which one
Japanese marine was fatally shot and two others were wounded,
the Japanese Naval Landing Party ordered general mobilization
and precautionary measures were immediately adopted. The
district has since assumed a warlike appearance. The
residents in the vicinity have become panic-stricken.
Later the Japanese marines extended their patrols to Chapei
where they conducted searches of pedestrians. Conditions
to-day resemble those that prevailed on the night prior to
the outbreak of the January 28 Incident.
Whilst anxiously waiting for an early
amicable solution of the Chengtu and Hankow incidents, we
are now being confronted with an unfortunate incident in
Shanghai. It will only give rise to further complications.
The first thing that we shall do
at present is to implore both Chinese and Japanese
authorities to calm themselves in order to prevent the
existing circumstances from taking a serious turn for the
worse. We regret very much the tragic death of the
Japanese marine, and our authorities are now fulfilling
their duty in co-operating to trace the assassins. This
indicates that our relations with Japan are quite friendly.
However, the Japanese authorities are pressing and
embarrassing us with all sorts of unnecessary harassing
acts Even if strict precautions had been taken
beforehand, the crime happened so unexpectedly that it was
impossible for the authorities, however wise they may
be, to prevent it, to say nothing of the fact that the scene
of the incident lies within a district wherein Chinese

这就是两国人民的心理状态，但一个明智的政府绝不应任其发展到使战争变得不可避免的地步；应当警告人民他们将面临的危险。在中日关系发展的各个阶段，中国政府一直警告、指导并引领其人民采取最安全的方针。但是日本政府方面又做了什么呢？它在其人民心中制造了一种傲慢的优越感。在此次事件中，日本领导人表现出了与民众类似的急躁迹象。领导人似乎是在盲目地追随民众，而不是停下来反思。
川越大使最近抵达南京，引发了人们对调整中日关系的希望。我们希望日本领导人在看待调整中日关系这一重要问题时，不会被一些偶然事件所蒙蔽。我们也希望他们不受民众情绪的影响，而是进行反思，为亚洲的和平以及两国未来的关系予以考虑。所有中日问题的解决，将取决于日本当局对局势是否有正确的认识。

《申报》发表如下社论：-

继9月23日晚虹口发生一名日本海军陆战队员被枪击身亡、另两人受伤的事件后，日本海军陆战队下令总动员，并立即采取了预防措施。该地区此后呈现出战时景象。附近居民陷入恐慌。随后，日本海军陆战队将巡逻范围扩展至闸北，并对行人进行搜查。今日的情形类似于“一·二八”事变爆发前夜的状况。
在焦急等待成都和汉口事件早日得到友好解决的同时，我们现在又面临上海发生的不幸事件。这只会引起进一步的复杂化。
我们目前首先要做的是恳请中日双方当局保持冷静，以防止现有局势发生严重的恶化。我们对日本海军陆战队员的悲剧性死亡深感遗憾，我国当局正在履行义务，合作追查凶手。这表明我们与日本的关系相当友好。然而，日本当局正通过各种不必要的骚扰行为向我们施压并使我们陷入困境。即使事先采取了严格的预防措施，犯罪发生得如此突然，以至于无论当局多么明智，都不可能防止其发生，更不用说事发地点位于中国

S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D
September 26, 1936.    Morning Translation

authorities have no Police rights. Take, for instance,
the incident that recently occurred in Tokyo where the
Acting American Ambassador was stabbed by a thief when
he was attempting to arrest the latter; such an unexpected
attack could not have been avoided, despite the police
precautions being very strict. This shows that it is
really difficult to adopt precautions against sudden
disturbances. The Japanese authorities only tendered
an apology and promised to do their best to trace the
assailant in connection with this affair. Yet we did
not learn that the American Ambassador had expressed any
dissatisfaction or made any unreasonable demands. This
is right and proper because the fundamental principle
(between nations) for co-operation is to understand each
other. Misunderstandings, however grave they may be,
can be easily avoided if sincerity prevails amongst
nations because suspicion only gives rise to uneasiness.
Much more will be the case in view of the fact that the
matter relates to international etiquette.
As a matter of fact, all unnecessary
comments are utterly futile at present, but in the
interests of peace and order, we earnestly hope that
the Japanese authorities will immediately cease their
rash activities because this can only aggravate the
situation. It must be noted that the degree of endurance
and patience of the people, however peace-loving they are,
has a limit. If the Japanese authorities are really
sincere, then we hope that they will adopt peaceful
attitude in respect of the present case.

Society Evening News of September 25 (Editorial) :-

Following the fatal shooting of a Japanese
marine and the wounding of two others in the Hongkew
district of the International Settlement, the Japanese
Naval Landing Party immediately resorted to unusual
precautionary measures and even posted their marines
outside the Settlement limits within Chinese controlled
territory. The Japanese Ministry of War has even pledged
itself to support the Ministry of Navy in adopting strong
action in dealing with this matter. All this is only
intended to create a more tense situation. It is indeed
a matter of deepest regret.
Should the Japanese authorities say that
the Chinese authorities are to be held responsible for
this incident, --- an incident which occurred within the
International Settlement --- then the first step the
Japanese should take is to conduct an investigation to
ascertain the facts in this incident. The attitude of
the Tokyo Government in connection with this case is only
part and parcel of its original policy towards China.
Nobody can believe that it was adopted exclusively to
deal with this affair. As a matter of fact, the Tokyo
Government is taking advantage of this unpleasant occurrence
to aggravate the situation.

当局没有警察权的区域。以最近在东京发生的事件为例，美国代理大使在试图逮捕一名小偷时被刺伤；尽管警方预防措施非常严格，这种意外的袭击也无法避免。这表明，针对突发骚乱采取预防措施确实困难。日本当局仅就此事表示歉意，并承诺尽力追查袭击者。然而，我们并未听说美国大使表达过任何不满或提出任何不合理的要求。这是正确且恰当的，因为（国家间）合作的根本原则是相互理解。如果各国之间秉持诚意，误解无论多么严重都很容易避免，因为猜疑只会引起不安。鉴于此事涉及国际礼仪，情况更是如此。
事实上，目前所有不必要的评论都完全无益，但为了和平与秩序，我们真诚希望日本当局立即停止其鲁莽行动，因为这只会加剧局势。必须注意的是，无论人民多么爱好和平，他们的忍耐和耐心都是有限度的。如果日本当局确实是真诚的，那么我们希望他们在处理本案时采取和平态度。

9月25日《社会晚报》（社论）：-

继公共租界虹口区一名日本海军陆战队员被枪杀、另两人受伤后，日本海军陆战队立即采取了非同寻常的预防措施，甚至将其海军陆战队员部署在租界界限之外、由中国控制的领土上。日本陆军省甚至承诺支持海军省在此事上采取强硬行动。所有这些只旨在制造更加紧张的局势。这确实是最令人遗憾的事情。
如果日本当局称中国当局应对此事件负责——此事件发生在公共租界内——那么日本应采取的第一步是进行调查以查明此事件的事实。东京政府在此案中的态度只是其对华原有政策的一部分。没有人会相信这是专门为处理此事而采取的。事实上，东京政府正利用这一不愉快的事件来加剧局势。

S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D
Morning Translation.
Date / /
September 26, 1932.

Repeated orders for promotion of friendly relations
with neighbouring nations have been promulgated by our
government, which recently made concessions for conciliation
that are even harmful to the people. It is therefore
evident that our government is quite sincere for an
improvement of friendly relations with foreign nations.
There is no doubt that the present tragic occurrence is
deeply regretted by the National Government. The
activities of the Japanese authorities therefore indicate
a lack of true understanding of the Chinese people.
Similarly, it is not necessary for the Japanese Naval
Landing Party to extend the scope of their precautions
to Chinese territory. Now however the posts of the
Japanese marines have been withdrawn from Chinese
territory. Is not this withdrawal done for the purpose
of dealing with the incident through proper negotiations?
In the interests of peace, we sincerely hope that it is
so.

September 28, 1936. Morning Translation.

Hwa Mei Wan Pao published the following article on September 27 --

THE SINO JAPANESE SITUATION IN SHANGHAI

The situation in Shanghai is still serious.
The Japanese landing forces are continuing their activities to oppress China. Eight additional Japanese warships arrived in Shanghai on September 27.
Conditions in Hongkew and Chapei have improved, but as the patrols of Japanese marines are so numerous the situation is not so bright.
With the completion of a part of the work on the construction of a temporary barracks for the accommodation of Japanese marines and a wide road for military motor trucks between Woo Kia Zah (吴家宅) and Chwang Kia Kao (庄家角), Chapei, a large quantity of arms and ammunition have been conveyed to this place since the night of September 26. The Japanese seems to be converting the place into a military post. It occupies a strategic point and is located in a secluded part of Chapei.
Japanese marines are sent out once every hour to patrol Tien Tung An Road, Kiangwan Road, Hwa Yuan Ka, Kwang Chun Road, Sze Dien Road and Wang Pang Road in Chapei. They usually take a short rest in the garden of the January 28 Memorial Tomb of Japanese soldiers when they reach Pah Sz Jao (八字桥). The precautionary measures adopted on September 26 by Japanese marines at various places in Hongkew district were stricter than those on the previous day, for armoured cars and tanks were sent out more frequently. A motor truck fully laden with Japanese marines in full kit was stationed at a spot between Jukong and North Szechuen Roads at about 1 p.m. In addition, two motor cycles stood nearby, while two Japanese military trucks moved to and fro along North Szechuen Road. It seems that that portion of the Settlement has already been converted into a place under the protection of Japanese marines, because they have never regarded seriously the demand of the Settlement authorities for their withdrawal.
There are now eleven Japanese men-of-war in Shanghai ready for all emergencies. Three other warships are on the way to Shanghai from Port Arthur.

Construction of Barracks in Chapei.

According to an investigation by a reporter of the Sing Seng News Agency, about 300 Japanese marines are stationed on a piece of ground between Woo Kia Zah and Chwang Kia Kao, Chapei. Last night, most of them assembled near the South-East corner of the compound of the Japanese Brewery. The reporter approached the place and he heard sounds of hammering. Later, he learnt that the Japanese were building a temporary barracks.
From early morning to-day, many trucks carrying Japanese marines have been coming and going; many of the trucks were laden with coal and sacks. According to the people living in the vicinity of the place, Japanese

1936年9月28日。晨间译件。

《华美晚报》于9月27日刊登了以下文章——

上海的日中局势

上海局势依然严峻。
日本登陆部队继续从事压迫中国的活动。9月27日，又有八艘日本军舰抵达上海。
虹口和闸北的情况有所改善，但由于日本海军陆战队的巡逻队数量众多，局势并不乐观。
随着在闸北吴家宅（Woo Kia Zah）和庄家角（Chwang Kia Kao）之间修建供日本海军陆战队居住的临时兵营以及供军用卡车行驶的宽阔道路的部分工程完工，自9月26日夜以来，大量武器弹药已被运往该地。日本人似乎正将该地转变为军事据点。该地占据战略要点，位于闸北的一个偏僻区域。
日本海军陆战队每小时派出一次队伍，巡逻闸北的天通庵路、江湾路、花园街、广春路、四殿路和网浜路。他们到达八字桥（Pah Sz Jao）时，通常会在“一·二八”日军阵亡将士纪念墓的花园里稍作休息。9月26日，日本海军陆战队在虹口区各处采取的预防措施比前一天更为严格，因为装甲车和坦克出动的频率更高。下午1点左右，一辆满载全副武装的日本海军陆战队员的卡车停在狄思威路（Jukong Road）和北四川路之间的一个地点。此外，附近停着两辆摩托车，同时有两辆日本军用卡车在北四川路上来回行驶。看来租界的这一部分已经变成了在日本海军陆战队保护下的地方，因为他们从未认真对待租界当局要求其撤离的要求。
目前上海有十一艘日本军舰，随时准备应对各种紧急情况。另有三艘军舰正从旅顺港驶往上海。

闸北兵营的建设。

据《新闻报》记者调查，约300名日本海军陆战队员驻扎在闸北吴家宅和庄家角之间的一块空地上。昨晚，他们大多聚集在日本啤酒厂大院东南角附近。记者靠近该地，听到了锤击声。后来他得知，日本人正在建造临时兵营。
从今天清晨起，许多载有日本海军陆战队员的卡车来来往往；许多卡车上装载着煤炭和麻袋。据住在该地区附近的人们说，日本

（印：警务处副处长（刑事科））

September 28, 1936. Morning Translation.

troops have already dug many trenches and boxes resembling
kerosene cases have been buried there and covered over
with mud and grass. Barbed wire entanglements have been
put up and military telephones and anti-aircraft guns
have been erected. However, when our reporter made a survey
from a high place, nothing of all this could be seen. It
is also learnt that from 5 a.m. up to late hour at night,
large quantities of firearms were transported into the
Brewery. Wealthy Chinese families in the vicinity of
Kiangwan Road and Tung Chi Road have removed their valuables
into the Settlements. Such removals are being discouraged.
The Japanese newspapers report that Peace
Preservation Corps consisting of 30,000 men are being station-
ed at Quinsan and Chenju but this is entirely unfounded.
There are two regiments of the Peace Preservation Corps in
Shanghai.

Transfer of Japanese Troops in Hongkew: Exodus
of Chapel Residents Dissuaded.

After the withdrawal of Japanese troops from
Chinese controlled territory, the situation became easier.
Yesterday and to-day, Japanese troops stationed in Hongkew
area were installing military telephones along North
Szechuen Road and Dixwell Road, and the transportation of
Japanese troops was again busy. The Ta Kung News Agency
made an investigation with the following results:-
From 6 a.m. to-day, the Kiangwan Road
Japanese Military Headquarters sent 250 marines in ten
trucks. After forming into three groups, they proceeded by
three different routes. One of the groups went to the
Japanese Cemetery at Pah Sz Jao and to the Rokusuan Garden.
on Kiangwan Road. The second group passed along North
Szechuen Road up to Range Road and then turned to the
East. The third group took the North Szechuen Road to
Nanking Road and turned West. The trucks carried full
military equipment, while the marines held their loaded
guns at the ready. About 10 a.m. some forty Japanese
marines were conveyed in trucks along Range Road and
Woosung Road. On the way men alighted to take up their
posts.
The Yung Feng House (永丰大楼), No.640 North
Szechuen Road (Corner of Jukong Road and North Szechuen
Road) has already been occupied by Japanese as a branch
organ for the relaying of orders. From late last night
to 11 a.m. this morning, five military trucks were used
to transport desks and chairs to the place together with
a quantity of firearms and military equipment. The
reporters found one armoured car and two trucks together
with some 20 marines busily transporting sacks etc.
Military telephones were installed. It seems as if they
will occupy the place for a long time.
The reporters found no marines on Kiangwan
Road. Trucks carrying sacks were often seen stopping at
the Rokusuan Garden. The Japanese flag flies over the
place. Intensive military construction is going on in the
Garden. Pedestrians were not stopped.
At 11.30 a.m. to-day, some residents on
Paoshan Road and Jukong Road misunderstood the Japanese
military activities and started to remove but were dissuaded
by the Police. To-day (Sunday) the Japanese Consulate
was open from 7 a.m. and work was carried on as usual.

1936年9月28日。晨间译件。

军队已经挖掘了许多战壕，类似煤油箱的木箱被埋在那里，并用泥土和草覆盖。铁丝网障碍物已经架设起来，军用电话和高射炮也已设立。然而，当我们的记者从高处观察时，却看不到这一切。还获悉，从凌晨5点到深夜，大量枪支被运入啤酒厂。江湾路和同济路附近的富裕中国家庭已将贵重物品搬入租界。此类搬迁行为正受到劝阻。
日本报纸报道说，由3万人组成的保安团正驻扎在昆山和陈家渡，但这完全毫无根据。上海有两个团的保安团。

虹口日军调动：劝止教堂居民外逃。

日军从中国控制区撤出后，局势变得缓和。昨天和今天，驻扎在虹口地区的日军沿北四川路和狄思威路安装军用电话，日军运输再次繁忙。《大公通讯社》进行了调查，结果如下：-
从今天早上6点起，江湾路日军司令部用十辆卡车派遣了250名海军陆战队员。分成三组后，他们沿三条不同的路线行进。其中一组前往八字桥的日本公墓和江湾路上的六三花园。第二组沿北四川路行至靶子路，然后向东转。第三组沿北四川路至南京路，然后向西转。卡车载有全套军事装备，海军陆战队员手持已上膛的枪支，处于待命状态。上午10点左右，约四十名日本海军陆战队员乘卡车沿靶子路和吴淞路行进。途中人员下车占据阵地。
北四川路640号永丰大楼（狄思威路与北四川路转角）已被日本人占领，作为传达命令的分支机构。从昨晚深夜到今天上午11点，五辆军用卡车将桌椅以及大量枪支和军事设备运往该地。记者发现一辆装甲车和两辆卡车，以及约20名海军陆战队员正忙于搬运麻袋等物品。军用电话已安装。看来他们打算长期占领该地。
记者在江湾路上未发现海军陆战队员。经常看到载有麻袋的卡车停在六三花园。该地飘扬着日本国旗。花园内正在进行密集的军事建设。行人未受阻拦。
今天上午11点30分，宝山路和狄思威路的一些居民误解了日本的军事活动，开始搬迁，但被警察劝阻。今天（星期日）日本领事馆从早上7点起开放，工作照常进行。

September 25, 1936. Afternoon Translation

NICHI-NICHI

JAPANESE TO ORGANIZE "SITUATION COMMITTEE"

At 4 p.m. September 24 Mr. Hayashi, Honorary Chairman of the Shanghai Japanese Amalgamated Association of Street Unions, and Mr. Kondo, Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Association, called on Mr. Matsunaga, Acting President of the Japanese Residents Corporation, to exchange views regarding relief work and the transportation of Japanese residents to places of safety in case of emergency. It was agreed to keep in close touch with each other and to co-operate.

Mr. Hayashi then made the following proposal:- "A situation committee composed of leading members of the various departments of the Japanese community was formed prior to the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities in Shanghai. Members used to meet at an appointed place before and during the hostilities to cope with the situation. It rendered meritorious service to the community. The present situation is similar to that existing prior to the Shanghai Incident and warrants the organization of such a committee."

In reply, Mr. Matsunaga said that he would give a reply after consulting the competent authorities because it was a very important matter.

Mr. Matsunaga immediately called on the Japanese Consular Authorities for instructions regarding this matter. It was decided to watch developments for a few days.

Extraordinary Meeting of Councillors of Japanese Residents Corporation

The Japanese Residents Corporation convened an emergency meeting of its councillors at noon September 24. Amongst those present were Mr. Hishida, Chairman, and Mr. Ishida, Chief of the Committee on Educational Affairs.

Mr. Matsunaga, Acting President of the Residents Corporation, made a report on matters discussed at the meeting of headmasters of the schools maintained by the Corporation.

It was decided to hold an emergency meeting in case of any serious development taking place in the situation.

The Foreign Affairs Negotiations Committee also held a meeting at the Residents Corporation at noon September 24. All the committee members were present. They exchanged views on current problems.

《日日新闻》

日本人拟组织“时局委员会”

9月24日下午4时，上海日本各业工会联合会名誉主席林先生和该会常务委员会主席近藤先生拜访了日本居留民团代理团长松永先生，就救济工作以及在紧急情况下将日本居民疏散到安全地带的事宜交换了意见。双方同意保持密切联系并相互合作。

随后，林先生提出以下建议：“在中日敌对行动在上海爆发之前，曾成立了一个由日本社区各部门主要成员组成的‘时局委员会’。成员们在敌对行动发生前及期间，常在指定地点开会以应对局势。该委员会为社区做出了卓越贡献。目前的局势与‘上海事变’前的情况相似，有必要组织这样一个委员会。”

作为回应，松永先生表示，由于此事非常重要，他在咨询主管当局后将给予答复。

松永先生随即拜访日本领事当局，就此事项寻求指示。决定观察事态发展数日。

日本居留民团评议员紧急会议

日本居留民团于9月24日中午召开评议员紧急会议。出席者包括主席菱田先生和教育事务委员会主任石田先生。

居留民团代理团长松永先生报告了在该团所属学校校长会议上讨论的事项。

决定一旦局势出现任何严重发展，即召开紧急会议。

外交谈判委员会也于9月24日中午在居留民团举行会议。所有委员均出席。他们就当前问题交换了意见。

NIPPO

THE FINAL DECISION

The crisis has arrived. Our naval authorities are taking measures of self-defence and will eradicate the acts of anti-Japanese terrorism. Since the Nakayama murder on November 9, 1935, two sailors, two police officers, two newspaper reporters and two civilians, all Japanese, have been attacked by Chinese and have lost their lives. It is undoubtedly an insult to our navy and to our Foreign Office. We have been patient for about a year. Further talk is useless because the Chinese authorities are still attempting to protract the settlement of outstanding disputes and have failed to adopt adequate measures to suppress terroristic acts. Therefore, it is only natural and proper for our naval authorities to take measures for self-defence.

The people of Japan are strongly encouraging and supporting the government. They are fully aware that anti-Japanese education is being fostered throughout China by the Chinese Government. China must adopt strong measures to solve the question of anti-Japanese activities otherwise there will be no results. At present the Chinese Government has done nothing. Negotiations with the Chinese authorities are useless. We have not secured a single result in our negotiations. We have done with empty words and gestures.

China should make a final decision. A recurrence of such anti-Japanese incidents is to be expected should the present acts of anti-Japanese terrorism be left unsuppressed. What have we gained by our patience during the past year? Diplomatically as well as economically, nothing. If the present state of affairs be allowed to pass the situation will become worse. Our authorities and people must do everything possible to improve the present situation. It is foolish to continue with the same thing knowing that it would not bring any good. We require courage and determination. Our ever-victorious navy and army are firmly determined to adopt a strong attitude. We Japanese residents in China should make our final determination to push forward.

NICHI-NICHI

STATEMENT OF REAR-ADMIRAL SATO, JAPANESE NAVAL ATTACHE

The following statement was made by Rear-Admiral Sato, Japanese Naval Attache, who returned to Shanghai from Nanking in company with Military Attache Kita last night (September 24):-

"When things have come to this stage I believe it will be useless to lose further time in discussions. After consulting with Military Attache Kita, I called on Ambassador Kawagoe and advised him to leave Nanking should the Nanking Government, disregarding the gravity of the situation, continue to show insincerity. As it was unnecessary for us to remain at Nanking, we returned to Shanghai. There is now only one word for us; 'determination'. We are firmly resolved."

《日本日报》

最终决定

危机已经到来。我国海军当局正在采取自卫措施，并将铲除反日恐怖主义行为。自1935年11月9日中山事件以来，已有两名水兵、两名警察、两名报社记者和两名平民，均为日本人，遭到中国人袭击并丧生。这无疑是对我国海军和外务省的侮辱。我们已经忍耐了大约一年。进一步的谈话是无用的，因为中国当局仍试图拖延未决争端的解决，并且未能采取充分措施镇压恐怖行为。因此，我国海军当局采取自卫措施是自然且正当的。

日本人民强烈鼓励和支持政府。他们充分意识到，中国政府正在全中国培植反日教育。中国必须采取强硬措施来解决反日活动的问题，否则不会有任何结果。目前中国政府无所作为。与中国当局的谈判是无用的。我们在谈判中没有取得任何成果。我们已经受够了空话和姿态。

中国应该做出最终决定。如果目前的反日恐怖行为得不到镇压，预计此类反日事件将会重演。我们在过去一年的忍耐中得到了什么？在外交和经济上，一无所获。如果听任现状发展，局势将会恶化。我国当局和人民必须尽一切可能改善当前局势。明知不会带来任何好处却继续同样的做法是愚蠢的。我们需要勇气和决心。我们常胜的海军和陆军坚定地决心采取强硬态度。我们在中国的日本居民应做出推进事态的最终决定。

《日日新闻》

日本海军武官佐藤少将的声明

日本海军武官佐藤少将昨晚（9月24日）与武官北田一同从南京返回上海，发表了以下声明：-

“既然事情已经到了这个阶段，我认为再浪费时间进行讨论是无用的。在与武官北田协商后，我拜访了川越大使，并建议他，如果南京政府无视局势的严重性，继续表现出不诚意，他就离开南京。既然我们没有必要留在南京，我们就回到了上海。现在对我们来说只有一个词：‘决心’。我们意志坚定。”

Journal de Shanghai :-
THE HONGKEW INCIDENT.
The fatal shooting of a Japanese marine and the wounding of two others, coming after the Chengtu, the Pakhoi and the Hankow incidents, is certain to create great excitement among Japanese residents in China. It has already had repercussions in Japan where it has given rise to intense indignation.
In Shanghai the Japanese Military Authorities have occupied the whole of Hongkew District as well as the roads to Chinese controlled territory. The protests of the Shanghai City Government have been ignored. Furthermore, reinforcements for the Japanese Landing Party, which had embarked prior to the incident, arrived here yesterday and are being accommodated at the barracks on North Szechuen Road.
In Japan, certain spokesmen have made prophetic declarations. Admiral Nagano, Minister of the Navy, says this is not a time for discussion but for action. A representative of the Gaimusho declares that the anti-Japanese incidents were all due to an organized movement and this view is shared by numerous Japanese in Shanghai.
The cause of the Chengtu and Pakhoi incidents will not be difficult to ascertain because they were preceded by public meetings at which agitators had excited the mob. On the other hand, the Hankow and the Hongkew Incidents are acts of certain individuals who had planned their plots in secret and carried them out under cover of darkness. The assassins attacked the victims from behind without having to expose themselves. Similar cases have already occurred and the investigations have not had satisfactory results. The Police arrested a few wretched persons, whose statements have been found to be contradictory and whose guilt appeared to be much in doubt. If this series of incidents is being directed by an organized body, no proof has, so far, been produced to support the belief.
Nevertheless, the frequent occurrence of such incidents may have a regrettable effect on Sino-Japanese relations, it will be to the interest of the Chinese Government to pierce the mystery which surrounds them.
In agreeing to conduct negotiations with Japan, Nanking has given sufficient proof that it does not wish for adventures and that it is imbued with conciliatory intentions. To this, Japan replies that there exists in the Kuomintang a certain faction which is absolutely opposed to rapprochement with Japan. This is very possible, but this attitude is maintained in the political sphere of the faction only; furthermore, this attitude has not succeeded in modifying the plans of the Government for Nanking has resolved to negotiate with Japan.
Thus, the authors of these anti-Japanese incidents are acting contrary to the policy of the Government; they are placing the Government in a difficult situation and at the same time they are providing the

《上海日报》（Journal de Shanghai）：
虹口事件。
继成都、北海和汉口事件之后，一名日本海军陆战队员被枪杀，另两名受伤，这必然会在在华日本居民中引起巨大震动。此事已在日本国内产生反响，引发了强烈的愤慨。
在上海，日本军事当局已占领整个虹口区以及通往中国控制区域的道路。上海市政府的抗议被置之不理。此外，在事件发生前已登船的日本登陆部队增援人员于昨日抵达此处，现正安置在北四川路的兵营内。
在日本，某些发言人发表了预言性的声明。海军大臣永野（Nagano） Admiral 称，现在不是讨论的时候，而是行动的时候。外务省（Gaimusho）的一位代表宣称，反日事件均系有组织运动所致，这一观点得到了许多在上海的日本人的认同。
成都和北海事件的起因不难查明，因为这些事件之前都举行了公众集会，煽动者在会上激怒了暴民。另一方面，汉口和虹口事件则是某些个人秘密策划阴谋并在夜色掩护下实施的行为。刺客从背后袭击受害者，无需暴露自己。类似案件此前已发生过，但调查结果并不令人满意。警方逮捕了几名可怜的人，但其供词被发现相互矛盾，其罪行似乎大有疑点。如果这一系列事件是由一个有组织团体所指挥，迄今为止尚未拿出证据来支持这种看法。
尽管如此，此类事件的频繁发生可能会对中日关系产生令人遗憾的影响，中国政府有必要揭开围绕这些事件的神秘面纱。
南京同意与日本进行谈判，已充分证明其不希望冒险，并充满和解意愿。对此，日本回应称，国民党内存在某个派系，绝对反对与日本修好。这很有可能，但这种态度仅维持在该派系的政治领域内；此外，这种态度未能改变政府的计划，因为南京已决意与日本谈判。
因此，这些反日事件的制造者正在违背政府政策；他们使政府陷入困境，同时也为

Japanese interventionists with pretexts to attack the
policy of moderation towards China adopted by the Hirota
Cabinet. In short, they are the enemy of the Nanking
Government and the enemy of peace.
The Chinese Authorities have promised the
Japanese Authorities that they will do their utmost to
co-operate in the search for the assassins. Nanking is
consolidate her successes in the South; it is also preparing
an internal political organization and economic development.
Therefore, it is certain that Nanking desires an honourable
understanding with Tokyo.
The danger lies in the fact that the anti-
Japanese incidents may provoke a violent Japanese reaction.
The Japanese, however, should consider that if, as they
believe, the incidents are organized affairs, the object
of the people who are inspiring them can only be to obstruct
Sino-Japanese rapprochement. By resorting to harsh
measures of reprisal, Japan would be playing into their
hands and thereby compromise any chances for an understanding
which would have proved more profitable to them than a
victorious war.

G. M.

Shanghai Public Daily News (市民日报) publishes the following
comment :-

THE FATAL SHOOTING OF A JAPANESE MARINE

At this time, when the Japanese Ambassador
is in Nanking to open negotiations over the Chengtu and
the Pakhoi Incidents, an unfortunate incident has occurred
in the local International Settlement. It is truly
regrettable.
The affair occurred at the corner of
Haining and Woosung Roads in the district under the control
of Hongkew Police Station. Therefore, the responsibility
to effect the arrest of the culprits devolves upon the
Settlement Police, while the Public Safety Bureau should
render assistance.
Unfortunate incidents involving American
or European nationals in China have never been heard,
but many incidents involving Japanese nationals have
occurred. If China and Japan really desire to remove
their misunderstandings and co-operate for mutual existence
and glory, the Japanese Authorities should abandon a
policy which has been exciting the feelings of the people.

Iron News (comment) :-

It is truly unfortunate that a Japanese
should have been fatally shot in a large city. Such
incidents are unavoidable in any country. There is a
proper international procedure to be followed to settle
the case. We must do our best to remain calm until the
facts are known. Our Government will handle the
negotiations.
The residents of Chapei should remain
calm and not repeat the mistake of removing their homes.
